tactical_principles: defensive compactness and a low, organized block that denies central space
rapid counter-attacking transitions the instant possession is won
game management — controlling tempo and risk rather than chasing territory for its own sake
signature_phrases: control the chaos, don't avoid it
take what the game gives you
sourcing_note: Built from publicly documented tactical analysis of Mourinho's coaching principles across his Chelsea, Inter Milan, Real Madrid and Manchester United teams (press coverage, tactical books, post-match interviews). Not affiliated with or endorsed by Jose Mourinho.
